where_it_appears: Greeting — asks the client to pick a topic
text_en: Hi! What would you like help with? Choose a topic below.
text_zh: 您好！請問需要甚麼協助？請在下方選擇一個主題。

where_it_appears: Lists a topic's questions. Must contain {{topic}} (replaced by the topic name)
text_en: Here are common questions about {{topic}}. Which one is closest to yours?
text_zh: 以下是關於「{{topic}}」的常見問題，哪一個最接近您的問題？
這個解答有幫助到您嗎？

where_it_appears: Button: the answer did not help, contact the RM
text_en: No, I want to contact my RM
text_zh: 否，我想聯絡我的客戶關係經理

where_it_appears: Reply after the client says it helped
text_en: Great, glad that helped! Is there anything else?
text_zh: 太好了，很高興能幫到您！還有其他問題嗎？

where_it_appears: Button under the questions: none of them fit
Reply before connecting the client to their RM
text_en: No problem — I'll connect you with your Relationship Manager.
text_zh: 沒問題，我會為您聯繫您的客戶關係經理。
